page_title: WHU 2-0 SHU | West Ham v Sheffield Utd 30/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+7' Wesley Foderingham leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham).
90+6' Anis Slimane (Sheffield Utd) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but the keeper dives and denies him.
90+6' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
90+3' The substitution has been made. Konstantinos Mavropanos (West Ham) has replaced Lucas Paqueta.
90+3' David Moyes has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pablo Fornals (West Ham) replacing Jarrod Bowen.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
90' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His low header flies toward the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
90' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) will take the corner.
89' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
89' Emerson (West Ham) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
88' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) releases Jarrod Bowen with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
86' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.

83' That was a nice football moment. Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the roof of the net. Wesley Foderingham guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!

81' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
79' Substitution. Jayden Bogle makes way for Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd).
79' Paul Heckingbottom decides to make a substitution. Cameron Archer will be replaced by Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gustavo Hamer leaves the pitch and Anis Slimane (Sheffield Utd) comes on.
77' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
77' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
76' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) connects with an accurate pass inside the box and fires the ball to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players steps in to block the effort.
75' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
72' David Moyes has decided to substitute Michail Antonio and he is replaced by Mohammed Kudus (West Ham).
72' Substitution. Edson Alvarez walks off the pitch and Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) comes on as a substitute.
71' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
71' What a great touch by Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
70' Substitution. James McAtee will be replaced by Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd).
67' Nayef Aguerd (West Ham) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just wide of the left post. Unlucky!
67' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
65' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
64' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) takes a good touch to control a cross on the edge of the box and shoots towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block his effort.
61' The number of shots on goal at present is 7:1.

57' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop the effort.
57' There's an opportunity for Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
56' It is time for a substitution. Chris Basham (Sheffield Utd) is on for John Egan.
53' The resulting corner from Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

51' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
51' It seemed like James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
50' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) attempts to feed Michail Antonio with a chip pass, but Wesley Foderingham reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Graham Scott blows his whistle and it's James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

44' What a save from Wesley Foderingham! Tomas Soucek (West Ham) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
43' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.

42' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Wesley Foderingham, who pulls off a comfortable save!
40' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Graham Scott had an easy-decision to make.

37' 2 - 0 Goal! Michail Antonio produces a great pass that finds Tomas Soucek (West Ham) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
35' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
34' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but Wesley Foderingham comes off his line to gather the ball.
33' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) dummies a defender then lets fly from the edge of the box, but the ball misses the left post by a mile.
32' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
30' Michail Antonio (West Ham) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
29' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Wesley Foderingham stops the ball from going into the top left corner.
26' The resulting corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is cleared by the defence.

24' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Vladimir Coufal, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Jarrod Bowen (West Ham), who beats Wesley Foderingham with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
23' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.

21' Sheffield Utd slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
18' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick just outside the box. The goalkeeper rises and gathers the ball.
16' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
15' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sheffield Utd comes to nothing.
15' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the right side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
14' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

14' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The linesman makes the right call and West Ham will have a corner.
12' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it high over the bar.
8' Michail Antonio (West Ham) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
8' Good movement by Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
5' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
4' West Ham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! West Ham will take the kick-off.
Graham Scott got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
